summary: Campus-specific secondhand marketplace platform with sleek, minimalist UI inspired by modern e-commerce designs. Users can buy and sell items within their campus community with features like multi-photo listings, messaging, favorites, user profiles, seller ratings, and campus verification.
architectural_notes: Frontend: React + TypeScript with Tailwind CSS for polished, responsive design
Backend: Motoko on Internet Computer platform
Image storage: Multi-photo support with optimization for fast loading
Campus-specific categorization: textbooks, furniture, electronics, dorm essentials, move-out sales
Responsive design: Mobile-first approach with full desktop optimization
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Clean minimalist hero banner for home page featuring campus theme with warm neutral tones (hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
- Campus marketplace logo icon with modern geometric design in warm earth tones (logo-icon.dim_256x256.png)
- Placeholder product image for listings without photos, simple line art style (product-placeholder.dim_400x400.png)
- Campus building silhouette illustration for onboarding background in muted colors (onboarding-bg.dim_800x600.png)

existing_features.title: Redesign the entire frontend with a sleek, minimalist e-commerce aesthetic inspired by the uploaded reference images (image-10.png and image-11.png), featuring clean product cards, smooth navigation, elegant typography, generous white space, and a cohesive visual identity that works seamlessly on both mobile and desktop

Build advanced search and filtering UI with category-specific filters for campus needs including textbooks, furniture, electronics, clothing, dorm essentials, course materials, and move-out sales, with sort options and price ranges
Implement urgent sale tags for end-of-semester listings, allowing sellers to mark listings as time-sensitive and prioritizing them in search results and feeds
Add campus meetup location suggestions feature that recommends safe, public meeting spots on campus when buyers and sellers arrange transactions
Implement saved searches feature allowing users to save search queries with filters and receive notifications when new listings match their saved criteria

Redesign home page with a premium dashboard layout featuring personalized listing recommendations, quick action cards, recently viewed items strip, trending section, and campus-specific widgets, all styled with the new minimalist aesthetic

Redesign listing detail pages with large image carousels, clear pricing and condition display, prominent save and cart actions, seller profile preview, chat button, and integrated safety tips, following the clean product detail layout from the reference images
Redesign search results page with grid-based listing cards, elegant filtering UI, category browsing chips, and smooth transitions, maintaining the minimalist aesthetic across mobile and desktop

Create a visually cohesive design system with a carefully chosen color palette (avoiding blue and purple unless specified), elegant typography hierarchy, consistent spacing scale, and smooth micro-interactions that give the app a premium, polished feel

Enable sellers to upload multiple photos per listing (up to 5 images), manage pricing, mark items as sold, and control inventory status with an intuitive listing management interface
